description: The Johns Islander's newsroom: the latest stories about Johns Island, Kiawah, Seabrook and Wadmalaw — roads, openings, the towns, the water, food and what's on — newest first. Each story carries its dek, its dates (published, updated, corrections) and the pages it rests on, each marked official, from the business, or reported by a named newsroom. Written with AI and re-checked against every source before it publishes (/standards). Quote with the story's link.

query.description: Words to match in the headline, dek, place or story, e.g. "Main Road", "Kiawah", "oysters"

section.description: news = News; eat = Eat; play = Play; water = Water; homes = Homes

name: wire

rule.description: Quote with attribution and the link

stories.description: Each: title, dek, section, place, published, updated, url, sources (label, url, kind), corrections
